_meta.note: Andon board is the primary source (normalized values as displayed + raw composite ± SE from the page bundle). Epoch / BenchLM / llm-stats copy the same board. arXiv 2509.25229 = Blueprint-Bench v1 (2025 models, unlabelled bars) — archived, no values.

benchmarks.name: Blueprint-Bench 2 (Andon Labs, normalized connectivity score)
benchmarks.description: Andon Labs Blueprint-Bench 2 (May 2026): agents turn ~20 interior photos per apartment into a 2D floor plan, 50 apartments in sequence with a persistent notepad. Composite of six connectivity-graph sub-metrics (Jaccard 50%, degree 20%, density 10%, room count 10%, door count 5%, orientation 5%) under D4 symmetry, normalized so the random baseline (raw 0.539) = 0 and perfect = 1; ×100 here. Human baseline 58.6 (raw 0.809) on a 12-apartment subset. Raw composite on `blueprint_bench_2_raw_composite`. Successor of Blueprint-Bench (arXiv 2509.25229, Sept 2025).

benchmarks.name: Blueprint-Bench 2 — raw composite similarity (before baseline normalization)
benchmarks.description: Blueprint-Bench 2 raw composite connectivity similarity (0–1, ×100 here) from the Andon Labs board data, before normalization; random baseline 53.9, human 80.9 (12-apartment subset). Standard errors in the row notes.
